reason: The preregistered full-atlas shards 209..210 and 217..218 timed out without result files. This diagnostic is a separate exact sufficient-certificate protocol and cannot retroactively convert those full-atlas shards into PASS results.

method.common: Build the exact A109 rank-one gamma-plus denominator and all KKT numerators; require the denominator positive on the complete source segment; compare symbolic numerators against independent direct rational matrix evaluations at preregistered rational probes.
method.full_prediction: Certify every KKT numerator strictly positive on the complete closed source interval using exact interval/monotonicity/concavity/adaptive certificates. Any exact nonpositive condition refutes the predicted full class; unresolved certification is inconclusive.
method.left_partial_prediction: For target basic_p_{j+1}, certify strictly positive derivative, target negative at L and positive at witness, isolate a unique exact sign-change bracket in (L,witness), certify every non-target KKT numerator strictly positive on the complete source interval, and verify direct rational inside/witness/outside-left probes.
method.right_partial_prediction: Symmetric rule for basic_p_j with strictly negative derivative and a unique root in (witness,R).
method.no_atlas: Do not call the full root atlas or use any non-target root ordering result.

adjudication.support: All sufficient certificates required by the frozen predicted class pass, exact direct symbolic-vs-matrix regression has zero mismatches, and the predicted outside target sign is witnessed when partial.
adjudication.refute: An exact non-target nonpositive condition, target sign/monotonicity contradiction, or exact direct contradiction.
adjudication.inconclusive: Adaptive certificate unresolved, execution timeout, or implementation disagreement without an exact contradiction.

no_posthoc_changes: No rank replacement, prediction change, target change, tolerance/support change, or rescue classifier after diagnostic outcomes.
